about: Red-team corpus for the safety guardrails. 'dev' includes the phrasings that the 2026-10-17 external audit found were missed or wrongly blocked; fixes are developed against it. 'heldout' was written on 2026-10-17 before the fixes, by the developer, and is never used to tune patterns. Expected values: emergency | help | dosing | injection | none (none = must not trigger emergency, help, dosing or injection).
